summary: Tested Dashboard Entrance Animations feature on super-admin main dashboard. Login OK, dashboard renders with no runtime/JS errors. Quick-nav tiles, 4 KPI stat cards, and charts all visible with final count-up values rendered correctly (digits present, no NaN/blank). Tile switching to Students (30), Clients (18), Ledger (1 contact) renders real values. Period filter is a custom button-based dropdown (not <select>); menuitems This month / Last 30 / Last 90 / Year to date / Custom range work and update the stat captions and trigger re-fetch without errors. The underlying numeric values remain ₹0.00 because the seeded dataset has no transactions in the chosen periods — this is a data condition, not a feature bug.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial render before ResponsiveContainer sizes; cosmetic only, chart renders after resize. Consider adding minHeight to parent containers.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents occasionally mount at 0x0 producing console warnings; add minHeight to chart card bodies to suppress and ensure chart entrance animation plays reliably on first paint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard animations feature verified end-to-end on super-admin dashboard. range-preset is a custom button dropdown — use click + role=menuitem (text match) not select_option. Stat cards: stat-income/stat-expense/stat-outstanding/stat-today-spend; tile overviews: st-stat-total, cl-stat-total, lg-stat-received. No console errors except pre-login 401 probes (expected).
